== Description ==
I'm so happy to announce that the new Hay Day update was released today! In my video you'll learn everything about all new features in the update! 

► List of all new features:

Introducing: The Sanctuary Valley!

• A fresh new Valley theme! Catch escaped animals and deliver them back to sanctuaries for tokens!
• Load up your truck with up to three animals at a time to get even more tokens.

Additional Valley features:

• More fuel opportunities! Find fuel stations around Valley. They will sell you fuel, and if you’re lucky, they might even give some for free!
• More rewards! Complete Valley daily quests to earn a new Lucky Bonus, from which you can win amazing prizes.
• Afford more rewards! Introducing the Piggy Bank, which allows you to collect extra tokens. Open the piggy bank at the end of the Valley season and afford more rewards! Or instead, keep you leftover tokens for the next Valley season!

Other New Features: 

• Diamond shop has new look!
• New XP menu feature!
